summary: Megan Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on October 1, 2026 it received a Nasdaq letter confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company had been notified May 12, 2026 of a 180-day cure window ending November 9, 2026; shareholders approved July 13, 2026 a consolidation up to 1-for-400, and the board set a 1-for-30 ratio effective September 17, 2026, after which the Class A bid stayed at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days through September 30. No price, premium, advisor, or deal terms apply; the delisting risk is resolved but the reverse split leaves a structural overhang, so watch for subsequent price erosion and any new deficiency notice as the arbitrage-relevant angle.
